scope: Coherent bounded supplied-reader directory-tree and file-stream observations within an explicitly bound ordinary-image volume. This extends the original filesystem scope; complete paged/provider/worker/frontend/platform/storage admission still needs its own evidence.
ownership: Reuse the existing root observer to construct an opaque move-only owned ExfatVolumeCapture containing actual root/system metadata and reread anchors. Preserve its existing JSON observations/read sequence. exfat_tree owns tree/stream collection; namespace owns supplied-record name interpretation, portable/exfat owns decoding. No native opening, scheduler, second format parser or public ABI.
binding: A root capture is constructed only by the existing reader/decoder/cardinality/active-bitmap/upcase/reread checks. Retain copied request, geometry, raw root report, root/system occupied clusters, original system bytes and actual read regions. Getters are immutable. The tree requires a mandatory applicable callback for the exact source_id/epoch/window and checks it before and after collection; reread all root anchors and every new observed region. This reports matched observed regions, not atomic snapshot or current-source/mutation authority.
streams: Reparse associated entry-set bytes using portable helpers. Require valid stream metadata before traversal/content. Chained streams require exactly ceil(DataLength/clusterBytes) clusters, end marker after the last, no cycles/crosslinks, and active-bitmap allocation for every cluster. NoFatChain uses exactly the contiguous extent, checks heap bounds/allocation, and never interprets or reads FAT cells for that extent. Root/system clusters and every participating file/directory share one ownership set. Preserve unsupported/incomplete facts and diagnostics; no automatic repair.
directories: Collect logical ordered32-byte records across fragmented or contiguous clusters, retaining actual source offsets. Entry sets may cross cluster boundaries. End markers delimit membership; later physical bytes do not become members. Directory DataLength is the entire allocation, whole-cluster, at most256MiB and may be zero; ValidDataLength equals DataLength. Reuse the namespace model and exact validated volume map for names; no host normalization/path opening. Unknown/invalid/orphan records and duplicate upcased names withdraw complete namespace claims. Bound breadth/depth/counts and report partial coverage rather than fabricated absence.
content: For ordinary files, observe the logical DataLength stream. Read source bytes only before ValidDataLength; bytes from that boundary to DataLength are defined zeroes and must not disclose on-media undefined bytes. Preserve read/zero provenance and digest of emitted logical bytes. Empty files/directories perform no data/FAT reads for an empty allocation. No output-file creation, extraction, writer or physical grant follows from a content observation.
acceptance: Independent generated-image chains/bitmap/record-offset and logical-content oracles; nested, fragmented and NoFatChain directories/files, cross-cluster sets, custom names and case/hash collisions.
ValidDataLength boundaries, zero filling, zero-length directory/file, nonzero offsets, activeFAT/bitmap and non-read of poisoned FAT cells or undefined tail bytes.

Cycles/crosslinks, unallocated clusters, short/long/bad chains, invalid streams, unsupported records, changed/short/null/failed reads, callback withdrawal and finite budgets retain precise incomplete facts.
Actual native build/headers, original root/namespace/file/worker/frontend regressions, exact source/import/context/artifact evidence. Untested targets remain unverified.
later_gates: Paged continuation for larger trees and bounded stream delivery/backpressure.
All original platforms/storage, owner acceptance, production writer/recovery and release.
